soldier.name: Brace & Dig In
soldier.desc: Drop low and set your feet: +2 armor until your next turn. Builds 2 TP.

soldier.name: Steady Aim
soldier.desc: Settle your breathing and line up the next shot: your next normal attack this round gets +2 TN. Builds 1 TP.

soldier.name: Dig In & Push
soldier.desc: Break from cover: move up to your squares, then fire at an enemy in sight for weapon damage.

play.gm: Moves up to their squares first.

soldier.name: Suppressive Sweep
soldier.desc: Pinning fire: one enemy, or two adjacent to each other, attack at −4 TN until the end of next round.

play.gm: Pinned until the end of next round (two targets must stand next to each other).

soldier.name: Overwatch Sweep
soldier.desc: Hold two lines of sight: a free shot at +2 TN on the first enemy that crosses each, before your next turn.

play.gm: Holds two lines of sight: a free shot at +2 TN on the first enemy to cross each, before their next turn.

soldier.name: Commanding Directive
soldier.desc: Bark an order: an ally in sight takes one free action right now (move or attack).

ally.note: Free action now: move or attack.

soldier.name: Coordinated Crossfire
soldier.desc: Mark a target: until the end of the round, allies attacking it get +2 TN and +1d6 damage.

play.gm: Allies hitting it this round add +1d6 damage.

soldier.name: Tactical Redeployment
soldier.desc: Every ally may move up to their squares without provoking opportunity attacks; allies who end in cover get +2 armor until their next turn.

ally.note: Move up to your squares without opportunity attacks. If you end in cover: +2 armor until your next turn (tick Braced).

play.gm: Every ally may move up to their squares, no opportunity attacks; those ending in cover get +2 armor.

soldier.name: Fix Bayonets / Charge
soldier.desc: Charge up to your squares into an enemy and strike: weapon damage +1d6, and the target is Prone.

play.gm: Charges up to their squares first.

soldier.name: Bunker Buster
soldier.desc: A brutal point-blank blow or shot: weapon damage that ignores half the target's armor, and cracks its armor by 1.

soldier.name: Reckless Execution
soldier.desc: Empty the magazine at point blank: roll weapon damage twice (melee: two strikes). Needs at least 3 rounds loaded.

soldier.name: Shift Stance
soldier.desc: Move one step between Defensive and Attack without an ability. No TP; you are Unsteady (−2 TN on attacks) until the round ends.

soldier.name: Field Strip
soldier.desc: Out of a fight: clear Jammed and top up both weapons from your spare magazines.

soldier.name: Cover Me
soldier.desc: Reaction, when an ally in sight is attacked: they're Covered — attacks against them at −2 TN until the round ends. Pays like Dodge.

soldier.name: Hard Stare
soldier.desc: Once per mission, out of a fight: roll your Class TN instead of Interrogation / Intimidation.

play.gm: Hard Stare: this roll stands for their Interrogation / Intimidation check (once per mission).

soldier.name: Human Shield
soldier.desc: Until your next turn, attacks on an adjacent ally hit you instead (your armor takes them).

ally.note: A Soldier shields you: attacks on you hit them instead until their next turn.

play.gm: Human Shield: until their next turn, attacks on the adjacent ally hit the Soldier instead.

soldier.name: Shoulder Charge
soldier.desc: Move up to 2 squares into an adjacent enemy and knock it Prone (no damage). Builds 1 TP; you end in Attack.

play.gm: Moves up to 2 squares into it first.

soldier.name: Breach & Clear
soldier.desc: Through a locked door or a weak wall with brute force. Loud: everyone near hears it.

play.gm: Breach & Clear: the door or weak wall gives way (breakable walls: breach it on the Deploy tab). Loud.

soldier.name: Second Wind
soldier.desc: In Onslaught: heal yourself 1d6 + your CON bonus and shake off Stunned.

soldier.name: Battle Plan
soldier.desc: Once per mission, out of a fight: plan it with the crew. At the start of the next fight every ally gets +2 initiative, and you start with 2 TP.

ally.note: Battle plan: +2 initiative at the start of the next fight (the Officer starts with 2 TP).

play.gm: Battle Plan: next fight, +2 initiative for the crew; the Officer starts with 2 TP.

soldier.name: Rally
soldier.desc: Allies in sight shake off Suppressed or Stunned and get +1 TN on their next roll.

ally.note: Rallied: +1 TN on your next roll.

soldier.name: Flank Order
soldier.desc: An ally moves up to their squares and gets +2 TN on their next attack against your target this round.

ally.note: Flank order: move up to your squares; +2 TN on your next attack against the Officer's target this round.

hacker.name: Ping Sweep
hacker.desc: Ask the networks around you who's there: every node and device within 10 squares, through walls, listed by network — never where they are. Works out of a fight too. The networks hear it (Trace). Until the end of the round, allies get +2 TN against devices the scan names.

hacker.name: Credentials Spoof
hacker.desc: Forge a high-clearance ID for you and one ally: synthetic systems (turrets, drones, doors) ignore you both, and organic guards accept you as authorised. Ends if either of you attacks.

ally.note: Credentials Spoof: synthetic systems ignore you and organic guards accept you as authorised while it lasts. It ends if either of you attacks.

play.gm: Synthetic systems ignore them both; organic guards accept them. Ends if either attacks.

hacker.name: Keylogger Injection
hacker.desc: Bug a cybernetic or synthetic target: the GM announces its next action before it acts. Each time it acts, you vent 1 heat.

play.gm: Announce its next action before it acts; each time it acts, the hacker vents 1 heat.

hacker.name: Thermal Dump
hacker.desc: Safe venting cycle: vent 3 heat. No offensive hacks for the rest of this turn. No roll.

hacker.name: Data Loop / Strobe
hacker.desc: Loop a strobe into the optics of a cybernetic or synthetic target: it attacks at −4 TN.

play.gm: Suppressed while the hack is sustained: clear it when it ends.

hacker.name: Feedback Loop (DDoS)
hacker.desc: Overload a target’s circuits: 3d6 damage to a synthetic target, 2d6 to a cybernetic one, ignoring armor. No effect on organic targets.

hacker.name: Overclock Pulse
hacker.desc: Push the deck past safe limits: your next instant hack this round hits two targets, or the same target twice.

self.note: Your next instant hack this round hits two targets, or the same target twice.

hacker.name: System Hard Reboot
hacker.desc: Emergency restart: clear all RAM and heat, but the deck stays offline for the rest of this round and the next. No roll.

hacker.name: Logic Bomb
hacker.desc: Plant a dormant payload in a cybernetic or synthetic target. When it moves, or when you release it, it detonates: 3d6 damage to the target and 1d6 to anyone adjacent.

play.gm: Planted: it detonates when it moves or the hacker releases it.

hacker.name: False Flag Broadcast
hacker.desc: Spoof a friendly-fire alert: a cybernetic or synthetic enemy spends its next turn attacking its nearest ally.

play.gm: It spends its next turn attacking its nearest ally.

hacker.name: Door Control
hacker.desc: Open, close or lock a networked or electric door you can see, or one on a network you have pinged.

play.gm: Door Control: open, close or lock the door they name (in sight or on a pinged network) — do it on the Deploy tab.

hacker.name: Comms Jam
hacker.desc: Enemy radios within 6 squares go silent: they can't call for help, and their next attack is at −2 TN. Works on people, through their gear.

play.gm: Comms Jam: enemies within 6 squares can't call for help; each one's next attack is at −2 TN.

hacker.name: Firewall
hacker.desc: Wrap an ally's cyberware — or the Tech Wizard's drone — in your firewall: hacks against it fail while it holds.

ally.note: Firewall: hacks against your cyberware (or your drone) fail while the hacker holds it.

hacker.name: Phish
hacker.desc: Once per mission, out of a fight: roll your Class TN instead of Deception or Persuasion, through a screen.

play.gm: Phish: this roll stands for their Deception or Persuasion check, through a screen (once per mission).

hacker.name: Bodycam Hijack
hacker.desc: See through a guard's bodycam or smart glasses: the GM tells you what it sees, and allies get +2 TN against that guard (Marked).

play.gm: Bodycam Hijack: tell them what this one's camera sees while it holds.

hacker.name: Spoofed Orders
hacker.desc: Someone with comms gets fake orders: on its next turn it moves where you say (up to its squares) instead of attacking.

play.gm: Spoofed Orders: on its next turn it moves where the hacker says (up to its squares) instead of attacking.

hacker.name: Camera Loop
hacker.desc: A camera network shows an empty loop while it holds — in or out of a fight.

play.gm: Camera Loop: the cameras they name show an empty loop while it holds (switch them on the Deploy tab).

hacker.name: Clean Logs
hacker.desc: Once per mission, out of a fight: scrub a network's logs — its Trace drops by 2.

play.gm: Clean Logs: lower the network's Trace by 2 (Deploy → Networks · Trace).

hacker.name: Backdoor
hacker.desc: Out of a fight: plant access in a network you have pinged. Your next ping there adds no Trace, and hacks on its devices get +2 TN this mission.

play.gm: Backdoor: their next ping on that network adds no Trace (trim it back); hacks on its devices +2 TN this mission.

hacker.name: Cascade
hacker.desc: Take a router or access point you have pinged offline: everything behind it goes dark.

play.gm: Cascade: the router or access point they name goes offline — everything behind it goes dark (Deploy tab: the node → offline).

hacker.name: Smartgun Lockout
hacker.desc: A linked weapon locks and can't fire while it holds — on a cyborg, a drone, or anyone carrying a smartgun.

play.gm: Smartgun Lockout: Jammed while the hack holds — clear it when it ends.

techwiz.name: Scavenge & Survey
techwiz.mend: Reveal cover and hazards within 6 squares; one ally gets +2 TN on their next Avoid / Reflexes roll.
techwiz.surge: Mark a weak point on an enemy in sight: the next hit against it ignores 2 armor.

ally.note: +2 TN on your next Avoid / Reflexes roll.

mend.gm: Reveal cover and hazards within 6 squares.

techwiz.name: Field Maintenance
techwiz.mend: Mend 2 cracks in an adjacent ally’s armor.
techwiz.surge: Crack an adjacent enemy’s armor by 2, or deal 1d6 to an adjacent drone.

techwiz.name: Improvised Cover
techwiz.mend: Raise Partial cover (+2) in a square next to an ally, until it is moved or destroyed.
techwiz.surge: Hurl the scrap plate: 2d6 to one enemy in sight.

mend.gm: Partial cover (+2) in a square next to an ally, until it is moved or destroyed.

techwiz.name: Targeted Overclock
techwiz.mend: An ally in sight gets +1 action next round.
techwiz.surge: An ally's next weapon hit deals +1d6.

ally.note: +1 action next round.
+1d6 damage on your next weapon hit.

techwiz.name: Restock & Repair
techwiz.mend: Fabricate 1 Tool Kit from scrap, or fully repair a drone or turret.
techwiz.surge: Salvage a wreck in reach: every ally reloads one weapon for free.

choose.label: Repair a drone or turret
choose.gm: Fully repairs a drone or turret.

ally.note: Reload one weapon for free.

techwiz.name: Fortify Position
techwiz.mend: A cover piece becomes Full cover (+4) until the end of next round.
techwiz.surge: Electrify a cover piece: an enemy in or next to it takes 1d6 and is Stunned.

mend.gm: A cover piece becomes Full cover (+4) until the end of next round.

techwiz.name: Rig Power Conduit
techwiz.mend: Adjacent allies get +2 armor until the end of next round.
techwiz.surge: A 2×2 shock zone for 3 rounds: 1d6 to anyone ending a turn inside; drones in it are Disconnected.

ally.note: +2 armor until the end of next round.

surge.gm: A 2×2 shock zone for 3 rounds: 1d6 to anyone ending a turn inside; drones in it are Disconnected.

techwiz.name: Healing Surge
techwiz.mend: Heal an adjacent ally 2d6 HP, or stabilise someone at 0 HP without a roll.
techwiz.surge: Corrosive injection at melee range: the target is Poisoned / Corroded.

ally.note: Stabilised: you are no longer bleeding out.

techwiz.name: Deploy Sentry
techwiz.mend: Your drone hovers as a barrier: Partial cover (+2) to allies in a 2×2 area behind it.
techwiz.surge: Your drone lands as a sentry turret (HP {hp}, armor {armor}) and fires at the nearest enemy at each round end: TN 10, {damage}.

mend.gm: Their drone hovers as a barrier: Partial cover (+2) to allies in a 2×2 area behind it.

surge.gm: Their drone lands as a sentry turret (HP {hp}, armor {armor}): add it to the combat as an ally; at each round end it fires at the nearest enemy, TN 10, {damage}.

techwiz.name: Structural Collapse
techwiz.mend: Brace the structure: pillars give the whole squad Full cover (+4) until destroyed.
techwiz.surge: Bring the ceiling down on a 3×3 area: 3d6, cover there is destroyed, targets are Prone.

ally.note: Braced pillars: Full cover (+4) until they are destroyed.

surge.gm: Cover in the 3×3 area is destroyed.

techwiz.name: Recalibrate
techwiz.desc: Tune the rig: +1 Sync, no roll. In a fight it takes an action, and you can't switch mode this round.

techwiz.name: Patch the Drone
techwiz.desc: Out of a fight: repair your wrecked drone. No roll.

techwiz.name: Jury-Rig
techwiz.mend: A broken device, console, vehicle or door works — for one use.
techwiz.surge: Sabotage a device, console, vehicle or door: it fails at the worst possible moment.

mend.gm: Jury-Rig: the broken thing they name works for one use.

surge.gm: Jury-Rig (sabotage): the thing they name fails at the worst moment — you pick when.

techwiz.name: Spotlight
techwiz.mend: Light a 3×3 area as bright as day until the end of the scene.
techwiz.surge: A blinding flash: enemies in a 2×2 area are Blinded.

mend.gm: Spotlight: a 3×3 area is lit (drop lights there on the Deploy tab).

techwiz.name: Triage
techwiz.mend: An adjacent ally heals 1d6 and loses Poisoned.
techwiz.surge: An adrenaline shot: an adjacent ally is Fired Up.

techwiz.name: Reinforce Armor
techwiz.mend: Bolt plates onto an adjacent ally: +2 armor until the end of next round (Braced).
techwiz.surge: Rip the plating off an adjacent enemy: it is Exposed.

ally.note: +2 armor until the end of next round.

techwiz.name: Mobile Workshop
techwiz.mend: An adjacent ally's weapon: Jammed cleared and reloaded for free.

ally.note: Your weapon is cleared and reloaded for free (reload it on your sheet without spending a magazine — the GM agrees).

techwiz.name: Steady Hands
techwiz.desc: Once per mission, out of a fight: roll your Class TN instead of Medicine / First Aid.

play.gm: Steady Hands: this roll stands for their Medicine / First Aid check (once per mission).

techwiz.name: Remote Pilot
techwiz.mend: Fly your drone up to {reach} squares ahead: the GM reveals what it sees.
techwiz.surge: Dive the drone into the enemy: 2d6 to everyone in a 3×3 area. Your drone is wrecked.

mend.gm: Remote Pilot: their drone scouts up to {reach} squares ahead — reveal what it sees.

techwiz.name: EMP Burst
techwiz.mend: Shield the crew's gear: allies can't be Jammed or Disconnected this round.
techwiz.surge: An electromagnetic pulse: cybernetic and synthetic enemies in a 3×3 area are Disconnected.

ally.note: Shielded: you can't be Jammed or Disconnected this round.

techwiz.name: Rig Trap
techwiz.mend: A tripwire alarm on a square: you know the moment anyone crosses it.
techwiz.surge: A shock trap on a square: the first enemy through takes 2d6 and is Stunned.

mend.gm: Rig Trap: a tripwire alarm on the square they name — tell them when anyone crosses it.

surge.gm: Rig Trap (shock): the first enemy into the square they name takes 2d6 and is Stunned.

techwiz.name: Calibrate
techwiz.desc: Once per mission, out of a fight: roll your Class TN instead of Mechanics or Electronics.

play.gm: Calibrate: this roll stands for their Mechanics or Electronics check (once per mission).

smuggler.name: Street Snap-Shot
smuggler.desc: Fire your readied gun (weapon damage, 1 round), then move up to 2 squares into cover.

play.gm: Then moves up to 2 squares into cover.

smuggler.name: Bribe / Distraction
smuggler.desc: Toss credits or contraband: an organic enemy in sight attacks at −4 TN on its next attack.

play.gm: Suppressed until its next attack.

smuggler.name: Pistol Whip & Rob
smuggler.desc: Strike an adjacent enemy for weapon damage without using ammo, and take one magazine or item from them (the GM says what).

play.gm: Takes one magazine or item from it: say what (send it with Give item).

smuggler.name: Adrenaline Rush
smuggler.desc: Sprint up to twice your squares without provoking attacks of opportunity.

play.gm: Sprints up to twice their squares without opportunity attacks.

smuggler.name: Contraband Stash
smuggler.desc: Pull something from a hidden pocket. Pick one: heal 1d6 HP; +2 armor until the end of next round; or smoke (2×2 area, attacks through it at −4 TN).

choose.label: +2 armor (Braced)
choose.gm: +2 armor until the end of next round.

choose.label: Smoke
choose.gm: Smoke in a 2×2 area: attacks through it at −4 TN.

smuggler.name: Safehouse Route
smuggler.desc: Guide an ally in sight through an unmonitored path: they move up to their squares without provoking attacks and lose Prone or Stunned.

ally.note: Move up to your squares without opportunity attacks.

smuggler.name: Decoy Deployment
smuggler.desc: Place a decoy within 5 squares. Until it is destroyed (1 hit) or the next round ends, enemies who can see it attack it first.

play.gm: A decoy within 5 squares: enemies who see it attack it first, until it is hit or the next round ends.

smuggler.name: Black-Market Ammo
smuggler.desc: Load special rounds into your readied gun. Until your next reload, pick one: its shots ignore half armor, or deal +1d6 damage.

smuggler.name: Desperate Gamble
smuggler.desc: Un-aimed full-auto sweep: weapon damage, rolled once, to every enemy in a 3×3 area. Needs 3+ rounds loaded and empties the magazine; your nerve crashes to −3.

smuggler.name: Call in Favor
smuggler.desc: Outdoors or in an unshielded zone, once per combat. At the start of next round, pick one: a sniper round (3d6 to one target, ignoring armor) or a flare (2d6 to everyone in a 3×3 area).

choose.label: Sniper round
choose.gm: Lands at the start of next round.

choose.label: Flare
choose.gm: Lands at the start of next round, on everyone in a 3×3 area.

smuggler.name: Breathe
smuggler.desc: Steady yourself or let it build: move the pendulum 1 step, cooler or hotter. No roll; in a fight it takes an action.

smuggler.name: Palm It
smuggler.desc: Out of a fight: hide one item or weapon on you from a pat-down. A scanner is the GM's call.

smuggler.name: Slip It Over
smuggler.desc: Hand an item or a magazine to an ally within 2 squares (Give item): they can use it this round.

ally.note: Handed over by a Smuggler: you can use it this round.

play.gm: Hands an item or a magazine to an ally within 2 squares (sent with Give item).

smuggler.name: Duck & Weave
smuggler.desc: Reaction, when you're attacked: you're Evasive — attacks against you at −2 TN until the round ends. Pays like Dodge.

smuggler.name: Fast Talk
smuggler.desc: Once per mission, out of a fight: roll your Class TN instead of Persuasion or Deception, for one lie or one deal.

play.gm: Fast Talk: this roll stands for their Persuasion or Deception check (once per mission).

smuggler.name: Quick-Draw
smuggler.desc: Before your first action in a fight: fire your readied gun at +2 TN (weapon damage, 1 round).

smuggler.name: Price Tag
smuggler.desc: Out of a fight: you know what something is worth and who would buy it. The washer's next offer to you is better.

play.gm: Price Tag: tell them what it is worth and who would buy it; your next washer offer to them is better (about +10%).

smuggler.name: Double Tap
smuggler.desc: Two shots at one target: weapon damage, then a second attack at −2 TN (2 rounds).

play.gm: A second shot at the same target at −2 TN: they roll it as an attack.

smuggler.name: Know a Guy
smuggler.desc: Once per mission, out of a fight: a contact comes through — information, a vehicle, gear at cost, or a door opened. The GM says what.

play.gm: Know a Guy: a contact provides information, a vehicle, gear at cost or a door opened — you say what and what it costs them later.

smuggler.name: Cover Story
smuggler.desc: Out of a fight: papers and a story for the crew. Each ally (and you) gets +2 on the next Deception or Persuasion check against officials.

ally.note: Cover story: +2 on your next Deception or Persuasion check against officials.

smuggler.name: Exit Plan
smuggler.desc: Call the route out: allies who move this round get +1 square and ignore difficult ground.

ally.note: Exit plan: this round, +1 square and ignore difficult ground.

smuggler.name: Bought Eyes
smuggler.desc: A bribed local tips you off: one hidden enemy is revealed, and allies get +2 TN against it this round.

play.gm: Bought Eyes: reveal one hidden enemy; allies get +2 TN against it this round.

scavenger.name: Case the Room
scavenger.desc: Sweep the area through your optic: place 1 Tell on each of up to 3 enemies you can see.

scavenger.name: Close Study
scavenger.desc: Get close and read them while you talk: +2 Tells on one adjacent enemy. Works in the open.

scavenger.name: Mark
scavenger.desc: Paint the target for the crew: allies get +2 TN on attacks against it until the end of the round.

scavenger.name: Lift
scavenger.desc: Take one item off an adjacent target: a magazine, a consumable, a small tool, keycards or creds, or a civilian weapon. The GM says what it carries (Liftable list).

play.gm: Takes one item from it: say what it carries (Liftable list) and send it with Give item.

scavenger.name: Misdirect
scavenger.desc: Feint and shift: the target's next attack is at −4 TN, and if it misses it hits another enemy next to it, if there is one (GM's call).

play.gm: Until its next attack; if it misses, it hits another enemy next to it (your call).

scavenger.name: Pin the Route
scavenger.desc: Call out its path to the crew: the target is Slowed until the end of its next turn.

scavenger.name: Jam
scavenger.desc: Tamper with an adjacent target's weapon: it is Jammed.

scavenger.name: Called Shot
scavenger.desc: Fire your readied gun as a location attack on your Class TN, with no −4 penalty: roll where it lands and apply that location's effect.

scavenger.name: Strip
scavenger.desc: Tear off a plate or disarm an adjacent target. Pick one: it drops its weapon (1 action to pick it up; an AI-locked weapon is useless to you), or its armor cracks by 2.

choose.label: Disarm
choose.gm: It drops its weapon (1 action to pick it up; an AI-locked weapon is useless to the crew).

scavenger.name: Kill Shot
scavenger.desc: Everything you learned in one shot: your readied gun deals weapon damage +3d4, ignoring cover, and its armor counts half.

play.gm: Ignores cover.

scavenger.name: Vanish
scavenger.desc: Slip out of sight: move up to your squares into full cover without provoking attacks. You count as not having attacked this round, so you start next round Unseen.

play.gm: Moves up to their squares into full cover, no opportunity attacks.

scavenger.name: Scan
scavenger.desc: Lean out and look: +1 Tell on your target, no roll. In a fight it takes an action, and you've shown yourself — no Unseen next round.

scavenger.name: Scrounge
scavenger.desc: Out of a fight, once per scene: search a room or a body — one small item, or a spare magazine for a gun you carry. The GM says what.

scavenger.name: Read the Room
scavenger.desc: Once per mission, out of a fight: roll your Class TN instead of Perception / Awareness or Forensics / Investigation.

play.gm: Read the Room: this roll stands for their Perception or Investigation check (once per mission).

scavenger.name: Spotter
scavenger.desc: Call the weak spot: an ally's next attack on your target can be a location attack with no −4 penalty.

play.gm: Spotter: an ally's next attack on it can be a location attack with no −4 penalty.

scavenger.name: Lead the Way
scavenger.desc: Out of a fight: the crew follows your route — everyone gets +2 on their next Stealth check.

ally.note: Following the Scavenger: +2 on your next Stealth check.

scavenger.name: Pickpocket
scavenger.desc: Out of a fight: lift something from someone who isn't fighting you, unnoticed — your Class TN against their Awareness.

play.gm: Pickpocket: their Class TN roll against the mark's Awareness; on a success they take something small, unnoticed.

scavenger.name: Dirty Trick
scavenger.desc: Grit in the eyes: your adjacent target is Blinded until its next turn.

play.gm: Blinded until its next turn.

scavenger.name: Sidestep
scavenger.desc: Reaction, when your adjacent target attacks you: you read it coming — Sidestepping, attacks against you at −4 TN until the round ends. Pays like Dodge.

scavenger.name: Plant a Bug
scavenger.desc: Out of a fight: plant a tracker on someone close to you. Later, you know where they went.

play.gm: Plant a Bug: a tracker on the person they name — later, tell them where that person went.

scavenger.name: Flush Out
scavenger.desc: A shot that drives your target from cover: it moves out, or stays and is Exposed.

play.gm: Flush Out: it leaves its cover on its turn, or stays Exposed.

scavenger.name: Long Look
scavenger.desc: Out of a fight: study a place through your optic from afar. The GM reveals guard numbers, patrols and timings.

play.gm: Long Look: tell them the guards, patrols and timings they could see from there (reveal squares on the map).

scavenger.name: Track
scavenger.desc: Out of a fight: follow someone's trail — footprints, scuffs, a door left ajar, a camera that saw them.

play.gm: Track: they follow the trail — tell them where it leads (and how fresh it is).

scavenger.name: Overwatch Spotter
scavenger.desc: Watch your target: until your next turn, the first time it moves, every ally gets +2 TN against it.

play.gm: Overwatch Spotter: until their next turn, the first time it moves, allies get +2 TN against it.
